propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() spans 408 lines (59% of runner.py) and has not shrunk despite three prior file-level splits, because each prior split extracted a callee while the calling method continued absorbing new work.

ProviderSession is constructed at runner.py:301 but its guarding try-block does not start until line 474, leaving a 173-line window where raises (including _check_tool_capability by design) leak an opened httpx.AsyncClient.

runner.py sits at 689 LOC against an 800 hard cap and a 700 headroom guard established by task 3a98; task cc33's +97 lines pushed it to 782, breaking the headroom and requiring extraction work to land before cc33 can merge.

Extract interpret_failure() from the except spine (75 lines, 58 code), build_model_settings()/build_usage_limits() from the settings block (80 lines, 36 code), and guard ProviderSession with a context manager, landing on stack in that order to keep each commit under 700 LOC measured per patchset.
The _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED side effect must remain inline in run() rather than move into build_model_settings() because structured_run.py is a leaf module and cannot import runner at runtime.

Six test patches targeting monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) must be repointed when their definitions move modules; the child commit that relocates each patched name owns all repoints of that name in the same commit.
